stem:
Falguni draws rectangle $WXYZ$. Point $P$ moves on side $WX$ and point $Q$ moves on side $ZY$. She wants to track how near or far $P$ and $Q$ are.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Measure the length of segment $PQ$; that length changes as $P$ and $Q$ move.
Track only the position of $Q$; the position of $P$ is not needed.
Nearness can be decided without placing $P$ on $WX$ and $Q$ on $ZY$.
$P$ and $Q$ are near when the printed letters look close on the page.

teacher.key_rationale: Nearness of P and Q is the length of segment PQ as both points move on their sides. Tracking only Q swaps away P. Dropping the side placements omits the setup. Judging by printed letter closeness is surface capture.
